Sadly, the website is not ready, but I want you to see where we're at still.

You all should know that I have a high level of quality control before release of anything. That said, I want you all to check out www.shirtposts.com to play around with the pre-alpha. There is still a lot of work (sadly) but we've come a long way since starting this version of the site. I originally spent over $10k developing the original version of this that went no where (read: waste of money). Our new talented dev has created this in the last 30 days and I am impressed / ever-grateful in his dedication.

The goal:

Shirtwascash is really awesome and people love what we stand for - fun, quality, community. It has had its trials to get to where we're at but it's sustainable from a business perspective and I am dedicated to betting every bit of profits towards the community side of this. We're almost 4 months since the Reddit ban and we're holding strong / growing. Community, for me, is to finish the new website and make it something really fucking awesome. It's been my vision since the beginning and I am thankful for how long we lasted using a subreddit.

In the design / shirt realm, previously sharing an shirt idea has been 100% financially motivated, limited in content type, questionable quality standards, and a silicon-valley funded business that wants profit for their Series A/B/C. Want a shirt? Okay, you have about this amount of space to do it and please market direct sales to us. It was a new and robust idea for affiliate sales professionals but that time is over - and not something I'm interested in.

My goals are completely aligned with the final release of our new website and focusing on people shit ... err... shirtposting their ideas. Yes, I want to make money for my time, eventually expand hiring so I am not doing everything anymore, and grow this - but the platform I am still dedicated to creating is for people - you - to have fun. No nickle & dimes. Just submit whateverthefuck you want and I will try to make it something you want to come back to, be rewarded for, and.. again.. have fun.

We will grow vastly beyond where we're at right now in the coming months / years and shirtposts will be the central hub for the community. If you've been around for our entire history, is has been such an amazing goal that we are finally nearing to begin. I thank you for sticking around and thank Voat for being the dark knight we needed. We will remain on Voat for as long as they'll have us p0wning their /v/all... (or not for hopefully their sake).

What will shirtposts be like?

If you visit the site, the general idea is to be the imgur / meme generator for shirt ideas but there is another idea I will expand on. We want to make cash shirts more of a platform than a centralized storefront. Shirtwascash will always be a integrated part of everything I do, but I want to make this platform available for others to copy before my - shittier - competitors think of it. I am going to target something I love, Twitch.tv, to have their own fans have their own boards on shirtposts to submit their own ideas. Instead of questionable-quality shirts with a logo on it, we'll do our premium all-over print for them, created by them. This is vastly different from the current services out there.

Instead of a one-off type design of their logo screenprinted on the chest of shirts, they fans can participate in their own shirtwascash-type community to express ideas and eventually buy shirts they love. Think of it was subverses / subreddits for their own communities within our platform. Outside of what they do, the boards of generic ideas and communities will be under the shirtwascash banner. So - /fit/ will be a shirtwascash thing and /twitchusername/ will be for them. Almost like an imgur or reddit for shirt ideas... we'll see how it goes though when it's ready.
